subject: Discovery recap: Observability & evals for ZenHealth
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@zenhealth.com>, Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap: Observability & evals for ZenHealth

Hi Sarah / Alex —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our call so everyone has the same next steps. If I missed anything, please reply and I’ll update the MAP.

Key pain points you called out:
- Limited real-time observability into inference latency and tail behaviors (hard to diagnose P50 vs P95 spikes)
- No standardized eval pipeline; manual scripts for A/B checks and spot-checks
- Difficulty tracking regressions after model/ prompt updates (no automated regression alerts tied to golden prompts)
- Risk management for rollouts — want canary + automatic fallback if quality drops

Current stack you described:
- Model hosting: AWS SageMaker endpoints (mixed in-house and vendor models)
- Monitoring: Datadog for infra metrics, custom scripts for evals, artifacts stored in S3
- Auth/compliance: SOC 2 soon in scope, KMS-based key management

Goals / success criteria (what success looks like for the first 90 days):
- Dashboards: per-route latency percentiles (P50/P95/P99), token-level cost breakdown, and end-to-end request traces integrated with Datadog or exported to a tracing backend
- Evals: a reproducible eval pipeline (golden prompt sets + scoring) that runs nightly on a snapshot of traffic and surfaces drift/regressions
- Regression alerts: automated alerts when eval metrics drop >2% or when production generation quality drops compared to golden set
- Rollout guardrails: canary deploys with automatic rollback on regression; ability to pin model versions for sensitive routes

Proposed next steps (owners & timeline):
1) I’ll send a mutual action plan (attached) with proposed milestones for a 6–8 week POC (deliverable: observability dashboard + nightly eval job). — Marissa (today)
2) Demo of Redwood tracing hooks + dashboard mock for your infra (30–45 min) — Wed Nov 4 10am PT (please confirm) — Marissa/Vivek
3) Technical touchpoint to scope data schema & KMS/SSO requirements (Vivek + ZenHealth infra) — week of Nov 9
4) POC kickoff: we’ll ship dashboard config + eval runner access; you’ll provide a sample traffic export and SOC 2 requirements doc — ZenHealth

Attachments: zenhealth-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (MAP), observability-dashboard-mock.png, golden-prompt-sets-v1.txt

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@zenhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@zenhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 16:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Observability & evals for ZenHealth

Thanks Marissa — this is perfect and aligned to what we discussed. A few clarifications / adds from our side:

- Stack notes: our SageMaker endpoints are behind an internal API gateway; we send traces to Datadog but they’re sparse for request-level model events. We currently attach a request_id to each user request and log to CloudWatch/S3.
- Compliance: SOC 2 is a hard requirement for buyers and will need KMS integration + audit logs for model artifact changes.
- Eval expectations: we’d like the golden prompt sets to include 8–10 production queries per route and example pass/fail criteria. Can you include sample scoring thresholds?
- Budget & timeline: headcount constrained; we’re aiming for a POC within November if possible.

Confirming Wed Nov 4 10am PT works for Alex and me. Please include a calendar invite.

Also: can Redwood’s tracing hooks emit span IDs we can correlate with our request_id? That’s critical for running causal debug.

— Sarah
VP Product | ZenHealth
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Observability & evals for ZenHealth

Nice capture, Marissa. A few internal notes for the POC: 
- We can surface per-request trace/span IDs and correlate them to request_id; will include a small agent/hook for the gateway (lightweight header propagation).
- Nightly eval runner: we’ll provide a containerized eval job that runs against a sample dataset and pushes results to S3 + triggers alerts via Datadog.
- Rollout guardrail: canary with automatic rollback on regression >2% or latency P95 spike >50ms versus baseline.
- Need SOC 2 doc + KMS requirements from ZenHealth before we can finalize credentials flow.

I’ll join the Wed 10am demo. Marissa — can you add Rishi (rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai) to the technical thread after the calendar is confirmed? He’ll own the eval runner integration.

Thanks,
Vivek
Director, Product Solutions | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@zenhealth.com>, Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Observability & evals for ZenHealth

Great — thanks for the quick reply, Sarah. Calendar invite sent for Wed Nov 4 10:00 AM PT (30m). I attached the MAP and dashboard mock in this thread; I’ll also drop a Drive folder with the golden prompt set and sample scoring thresholds: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-zenhealth-observability

Action items before Wed:
- ZenHealth: send SOC 2 scoping doc + a small sample of request logs (anonymized) we can use for the demo (Alex / Sarah)
- Redwood: prepare a short demo of tracing hooks + dashboard and a sample golden prompt set + scoring thresholds (Marissa / Vivek / Rishi)

If all looks good on Wed we’ll propose a 6-week POC plan in the attached MAP and aim to get the nightly eval runner live in week 2.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa
